blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate on Monday unanimously approved on third reading the Sagip Bata Act and the Comprehensive School Safety Act – two bills protecting children in online spaces and schools. Sponsored by Sen. Risa Hontiveros, Senate Bill no. 1819 or the Safeguarding Against Grooming, Inducement and Predation and Building Accountability for Technology-Facilitated Abuse or Exploitation (Sagip Bata) Act, is aimed at protecting children from all forms of violence, abuse, and exploitation. The Sagip Bata Act, once signed into law, will take the place of Republic Act No. 11930 or the Anti-Online Sexual Abuse or Exploitation of Children (OSAEC) and […]...
